categories.label: Fun
tasks: Sing the chorus of the last song you listened to.
Do your best impression of someone in the room — they guess who.
Talk in an accent of the group's choice until your next turn.
Walk like a penguin around the table.
Tell a joke. If nobody laughs, tell another one.
Make up a 4-line rap about the person on your left.
Do the chicken dance for 15 seconds.
Act like your favourite animal until your next turn.
Say the alphabet backwards as fast as you can.
Try to lick your elbow. Good luck.
Speak only in questions until your next turn.
Invent a new word and explain what it means.
Describe a famous movie badly — the group guesses which one.
Do your best evil-villain laugh.
Narrate the next turn like a sports commentator.
Pose like a statue until someone laughs.
Show the group the last photo in your camera roll (or do 10 squats).
Give a 30-second TED talk about socks.
Let the group choose a new nickname for you for the rest of the game.
Read your last sent text in a dramatic voice.
Do a runway walk across the room.
Draw a portrait of the player on your right in 30 seconds.

categories.label: Social
tasks: Give a genuine compliment to everyone at the table.
Share your most embarrassing moment.
Answer one question from the group honestly.
Tell us something nobody here knows about you.
What's the best advice you've ever received?
Swap seats with any player you choose.
Describe your perfect day in three sentences.
Name your guilty-pleasure song and hum it.
Which player would survive longest in a zombie apocalypse? Explain.
Tell the story of how you met the person on your left.
Truth or dare — the group decides which.
What's the weirdest food you've ever eaten?
Reveal your phone's screen time from yesterday.
Choose a player to take this dare for you — then do theirs next turn.
Share your worst job or worst holiday story.
Name three things you're grateful for right now.
If you could live anywhere for a year, where and why?
Everyone says one word to describe you. Guess who said what.

categories.label: Physical
tasks: Do 10 push-ups (knees allowed).
Hold a plank for 30 seconds.
Do 15 jumping jacks.
Balance on one foot until your next turn.
Do 10 squats while saying the alphabet.
Play your next turn with your non-dominant hand.
Play your next turn with one eye closed.
Hold a wall sit for 30 seconds.
Touch your toes and hold for 20 seconds.
Do your best dance move for 10 seconds.
Spin around five times, then pull your next block immediately.
Do 5 burpees.
Hop on one leg around the table.
Do a yoga tree pose for 20 seconds.

categories.label: Brain teasers
tasks: Name 5 countries that start with the letter B in 15 seconds.
Name 5 animals that live in the sea in 10 seconds.
Name the capital of 3 countries the group chooses.
Spell your full name backwards.
Count down from 50 in sevens: 50, 43… Mistake = pull another block.
Name 10 fruits in 20 seconds.
Name 4 Harry Potter characters in 10 seconds.
Say a tongue twister 3 times fast: 'Red lorry, yellow lorry'.
Name 5 brands that start with S.
Name 3 movies with a number in the title.
List the planets in order from the Sun.
Name 5 Disney movies in 15 seconds.
Name 6 car brands in 15 seconds.
Name the 7 continents.
Name 5 things you find in a kitchen that start with P.
Name 3 words that rhyme with 'game' — then 3 more.

categories.label: Drinking 🍻
tasks: Take a sip. That's it. Enjoy.
Everyone who has been to another country drinks.
Choose someone to drink with you.
Waterfall: everyone drinks until you stop.
The last person to touch their nose drinks.
Make a rule. Anyone who breaks it drinks.
Never have I ever — say one. Whoever has, drinks.
Drink if you've texted an ex this year.
The youngest player drinks.
The person with the most recent birthday drinks.
Categories: pick a category; go around the table — first to fail drinks.
Give out 3 sips to anyone you like.
Drink if you're wearing black.
Toast to the player on your right and you both drink.
Rhyme time: say a word, go around rhyming it — first to fail drinks.
